decisions.reason: The cleaning soap got its own page in 2024, which signals growing public commitment, and it completes the care range for the firm's established floors at little cost.
The maintenance oil line has several models and fits the firm's surface-treatment offer, so the investment and the link to its oiled floors justify keeping it despite only modest website visibility.
The care product line for oiled floors now has its own page and several models, which reflects rising commitment and its central role in the maintenance offer.

The high-density underlay supports the firm's flooring system, but it overlaps with Product D, which gives it a slightly higher risk of being consolidated.
